rule: Not used to write or tune detectors. FastAPI route counts come from the detector's extract() for counting only. GitHub Actions counts come from parsing the workflow YAML directly.

GitHub Actions: at least 30 jobs and steps, open-source licence, ranked by job-level timeout-minutes lines. Candidate rules are keyword-based and written before the detector was measured on these repos.
